## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths before matching requests — For `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, you return `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. The membership check omits the normalization that `select_explicit` uses when matching. — Users rerunning requested failures receive an incomplete selection when their report contains paths prefixed with `./`. — Fix: Match with `normalize(path) in requested` while preserving the original path, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.
